proof_body:
by
  intro a
  have hd : HasDerivAt (fun x : ℝ => Real.sin (a / 2 * x)) (a / 2) 0 := by
    have h : HasDerivAt (fun y : ℝ => a / 2 * y) (a / 2) 0 := ((hasDerivAt_id' (0 : ℝ)).const_mul (a / 2)).congr_deriv (by ring)
    exact h.sin.congr_deriv (by simp)
  have hs := hasDerivAt_iff_tendsto_slope.mp hd
  have hlim : Filter.Tendsto (fun x : ℝ => 2 * (slope (fun x : ℝ => Real.sin (a / 2 * x)) 0 x) ^ 2) (nhdsWithin 0 {0}ᶜ) (nhds (2 * (a / 2) ^ 2)) := (hs.pow 2).const_mul 2
  rw [show 2 * (a / 2) ^ 2 = a ^ 2 / 2 by ring] at hlim
  refine hlim.congr' ?_
  filter_upwards [self_mem_nhdsWithin] with x hx
  have hx0 : x ≠ 0 := hx
  have hcos : Real.cos (a * x) = 1 - 2 * Real.sin (a / 2 * x) ^ 2 := by
    have := Real.cos_two_mul (a / 2 * x)
    rw [show 2 * (a / 2 * x) = a * x by ring] at this
    rw [this]
    linarith [Real.sin_sq_add_cos_sq (a / 2 * x)]
  rw [hcos, slope_def_field]
  simp only [mul_zero, Real.sin_zero, sub_zero]
  field_simp
  ring
target_source: ∀ (a : ℝ), Filter.Tendsto (fun x : ℝ => (1 - Real.cos (a * x)) / x ^ 2) (nhdsWithin 0 {0}ᶜ) (nhds (a ^ 2 / 2))
